def-qftx-weighted-topological-model:
## Definition

Assume full AC and its inherited countable-choice consequences. Let $\mathcal C$ be a complex modular ribbon fusion category with finite simple-label set $I$, unit label $0$, simple pivotal dimensions $d_i$, twists $\theta_i$, and Hopf-link matrix $s$. Choose a square root $D\in\mathbb C\setminus\{0\}$ of $\sum_{i\in I}d_i^2$ and set $S=s/D$, $p_+=\sum_{i\in I}\theta_i d_i^2$, and $\kappa=p_+/D$. Modularity means that $s$ is invertible; no positivity of $d_i$ or $D$ is assumed.

Use the weighted Lagrangian ribbon-bordism category. An object is a closed oriented surface $\Sigma$ with a finite collection of marked points carrying simple-object labels and disjoint oriented interval germs, together with a Lagrangian $\lambda\subset H_1(\Sigma;\mathbb R)$ for the signed intersection form. A morphism is a compact oriented smooth three-bordism with fixed product collars and boundary parametrizations, a properly embedded colored ribbon graph with actual coupon morphisms and collar-product boundary ribbons, and an integer weight $n$. For a bordism $M:\Sigma_0\to\Sigma_1$, its homology relation is $R_M=\{(x_0,x_1):j_0x_0=j_1x_1\}$ under the boundary inclusion maps. For composable bordisms $M_1:\Sigma_0\to\Sigma_1$ and $M_2:\Sigma_1\to\Sigma_2$, let $R_1,R_2$ be their individual relations and let $R^t$ denote relation transpose. In the specified middle surface, set $K_1=R_1(\lambda_0)$, $K_0=\lambda_1$, and $K_2=R_2^t(\lambda_2)$; composition assigns weight $n_2+n_1+\mu(K_1,K_0,K_2)$, with the Walker signature/Maslov sign and order. Here $\mu$ is the signature of the Wall form on the triple of middle Lagrangians. For a parametrized genus-$g$ surface with ordered labels $W_1,\ldots,W_n$, write $H=\bigoplus_{i\in I}i\otimes i^*$ and

$$V(\Sigma;W_1,\ldots,W_n)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(\mathbf 1,W_1\otimes\cdots\otimes W_n\otimes H^{\otimes g}).$$

The weighted RT model is this category, these finite-dimensional complex state spaces, and the exact surgery-defined symmetric monoidal functor $Z$ of the supplied theorem. It includes actual coupon morphisms, disconnected bordisms and empty ends; increasing an integer weight by one multiplies the map by $\kappa$. The model retains the full anomaly and asserts no ordinary anomaly-free functor unless cancellation data are supplied separately.
prop-qftx-modular-dimension-sewing:
## Statement

Assume full AC and its inherited countable-choice consequences. Let $\mathcal C$ be a complex modular ribbon fusion category with simple-label set $I$, unit label $0$, simple dimensions $d_i$, Hopf-link matrix $s$, and a chosen square root $D$ of $\sum_{i\in I}d_i^2$. Put $S=s/D$ and $H=\bigoplus_{i\in I}i\otimes i^*$. In the weighted RT model, define the closed unmarked genus-$g$ state space by $V(\Sigma_g)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(\mathbf1,H^{\otimes g})$. For every integer $g\ge0$,

$$\dim_{\mathbb C}V(\Sigma_g)=\sum_{i\in I}S_{0i}^{\,2-2g},$$

with no complex conjugation in this formula. The sphere state space has dimension one, and the unmarked torus has dimension $|I|$ with basis $b_i:\mathbf1\to i\otimes i^*\subset H$. For every compatible separating or nonseparating circle cut, the actual normalized RT tube map from the complete direct sum of dual-label channels to the glued state space is an isomorphism; its inverse is the complete cutting resolution, retaining all multiplicities, markings, tensor orders, and Lagrangian identifications.

For the torus convention, orient the meridian/longitude basis $(m,l)$ by $\omega(m,l)=1$ and choose reference and object Lagrangians $\alpha=\lambda=\mathbb Rm$. The positive Hopf mapping-cylinder class and positive core-twist class have respective matrices

$$s_+=\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\-1&0\end{pmatrix},\qquad t=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix},$$

with columns the images of $m,l$. Their operators are $S_{ji}=s_{ji}/D$ and $T_{ji}=\delta_{ji}\theta_i$, where $s$ is the Hopf-link matrix of $\mathcal C$. For this positive pair, $S^2=C$ and $(ST)^3=\kappa I$, with $C_{ji}=\delta_{j,i^*}$. The inverse Hopf class $s_-=s_+^{-1}$ acts by $S^{-1}$ and satisfies $(S^{-1}T)^3=\kappa C$; when labels are not all self-dual, $C$ need not be $I$.
prop-qftx-weight-anomaly-obstruction:
## Statement

Assume full AC and its inherited countable-choice consequences, and fix a weighted RT bordism $M$ with all its boundary data, ribbon graph, object Lagrangians, and coupons held fixed. If its integer weight is $n$, then $Z(M,n+1)=\kappa Z(M,n)$. If $\kappa\ne1$ and $Z(M,n)$ is a nonzero linear map, the weighted RT assignment cannot factor through the operation that forgets integer weights while keeping the same maps. This obstruction concerns ordinary forgetting of the weight; an anomaly-canceling enlargement or a different normalization requires separate data and is not asserted here.
